[b]Please create backup copies of your savegame files before switching to the BETA Update. Savegames may not be compatible with the new version of the game.[/b]

[olist]
[*] In your Library, you click with the right mouse button on the entry of the "Fernbus Simulator"
[*] In the drop-menu, you click on the entry "Properties"
[*] In the window "Fernbus Simulator - Properties" you select the tab "BETAS"
[*] In the field "Select the beta you would like to opt into:" select the entry "beta-beta"

This time with the much-anticipated Poland add-on, which will be released on Steam for PC on March 21! 
Budding bus drivers can finally travel through the heart of Central Europe, explore 682 km of new roads and take passengers to 17 new bus stops spread across 15 cities in the country.😊🚌

Poland, known for its rich cultural heritage and diverse landscapes, is now waiting to be explored in the long-distance bus simulator. From the bustling streets of Warsaw to the historic charm of Krakow and the maritime charm of Gdansk, players have the opportunity to travel through 15 vibrant cities, each with its own unique atmosphere and attractions.

In Fernbus Simulator, players drive their own routes including night trips between the bus stations of numerous cities. They remain connected to the control center at all times of the day and year. Construction sites, traffic jams and accidents pose constant challenges to the tight schedule. Licensed and faithfully reproduced coaches are used for driving.

notes.title: Update 25 - Officially Released
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26064558/020f65dc4f1eeabbcb62a78e8e39dbd2ef0c5621.jpg[/img]

Update 25 has been officially released!

In this update, we have primarily dealt with technical innovations. Thanks to the support of [url=https://gaming.tobii.com/products/]Tobii Gaming[/url], we were able to implement the Eye Tracker with which our players, if they have the hardware, can experience the unique Tobii Eye Tracking.

Furthermore, it was possible for us, in cooperation with [url=https://fanatec.com/eu-de/]Fanatec[/url], to optimize our Fernbus Simulator with the appropriate hardware, the input of the devices now works correctly.

We would like to thank both companies for the uncomplicated and great cooperation!


With this update, we also turned to telemetry and added a first BETA output and input, which we will continue to deal with in the coming updates.
A completely new feature in our game is the shuttle mode, in which you can drive our mini and midibuses.

Hey community!

We would like to breathe new life into this contest and challenge you to another round :)

This time the whole thing will be called "[b]Repaint of the Month[/b]" and we would like to see your best repaint of a bus of your choice. There will be a theme this time and of course that's "[b]France[/b]"!

- Each participant can submit only one repaint, so make sure you choose your best.
- The repaint must be recreated and not be the copy of an existing one.
- The screenshot must be created from the game and may not be edited.
- The repaint must be available for download on Steam. Please label this one in the description "Repaint of the Month October 2019" to make it easier for everyone.
- You must submit your repaint by noon on November 29, 2019 (is not quite a month, we know :))
- You need to leave the link to your screenshot on our thread in the forum, so the community is able to choose (not Facebook, Twitter etc.): https://www.tml-studios.de/forum/index.php?thread/2255-repaint-of-the-month-raffle/


The participant agrees that in case of a win his name will be published on our social media channels. The contest is not affiliated with any social media platform or Steam, it is not sponsored, sponsored or organized by them. The legal process is excluded. notes.title: Update 21 - RELEASE
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26064558/0dbe025623b7cf2189ac12869d3be50970beef53.jpg[/img]

For Update 21 we have optimized a lot to get better performance. We hope that your PC systems will also benefit from this new update. In addition, we redesigned the physics of driving and vehicle sound systems to enhance the feeling of driving a large vehicle and make it more believable. notes.title: Update 21 - BETA - Behind the scenes
notes.content:
You may be wondering what we actually did for Update 21 to optimize performance? Here is a good example of optimization work in graphics.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26064558/dea01f48b1dfe6f9eee92ce0ae112f150fb3b4e2.jpg[/img]

Our programmers have identified various settings of graphical assets, which drag down performance and then implemented these warning symbols. So our graphic artists can now see directly in the game editor which assets still draw unnecessary performance and fix them immediately.

Many assets are instanced and the correction of a single error can remove several warning symbols at once. Correcting these unoptimized graphics assets bit by bit makes performance stay more consistent, resulting in fewer FPS drops, and slightly more performance.

Of course this is not all we have done for Update 21's on Optimization, but hopefully, it will give you some insight into the effort behind the optimizing process of this update.

So far we've been able to stabilize the overall performance and improve it slightly. We'll keep on digging until we find the motherload.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26064558/334c6a19bb7e4f146532697ab39aaca363f82fff.jpg[/img]

Anyway, we read the forums here on Steam and Facebook and know that some of you still aren't completely satisfied with the driving physics. That's why we're beginning to overhaul our driving physics vehicle by vehicle for the next update. Of course, we've started with the MAN Lion's Coach.

Stay tuned for more Infos.

notes.title: DLC Neoplan Skyliner and DLC ComfortClass HD now available for Tourist Bus too!
notes.content:
Today we've released two vehicle DLC for Tourist Bus Simulator.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/953682/Tourist_Bus_Simulator__Neoplan_Skyliner/]DLC Neoplan Skyliner[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/953680/Tourist_Bus_Simulator__Comfort_Class_HD/]DLC ComfortClass HD[/url] are ready for purchase on Fuerteventura to add more variety to your vehicle fleet.

Sounds familiar? Well, for those of you that own [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/427100/Fernbus_Simulator/]Fernbus Simulator[/url] may know these vehicles already because we've ported these vehicles from Fernbus Sim to Tourist Bus Sim.

[h1]And best of all about this: [/h1]
[b]These DLC's are compatible with both games! No need two pay more than once.[/b]

So, if you have already purchased these DLC's for Fernbus Sim, you'll find them available in Tourist Bus Sim right away. And vice versa: should you buy one of these DLC's for Tourist Bus they'll be waiting for you in Fernbus too.

This is from us, TML Studios, for you as a thank you!

notes.content:

notes.title: Update 1.18.19587 - Fernbus Simulator Revisualized
notes.content:
This update brings an overhaul of the environment graphics, skylight and post-processing, but it's not just all about the eye candy. We've been working under the hood as well, and the driving physics have been updated for all coaches. Including to that, performance and streaming have been improved and optimized.

[b]Physics[/b]
[list][*]Driving physics of all coaches have been updated
[*][b]Acceleration and deceleration bug when driving on slopes has been fixed[/b]
[*]ComfortClasses should accelerate faster
[/list]


[b]Graphics[/b]
[list][*][b]All landscape textures have been overhauled[/b]
[*][b]The entire vegetation has been overhauled[/b]
[*]The skylight has been updated
[*]Post-processing has been updated
[*]Further minor bug fixes
[/list]


[b]GUI[/b]
[list][*]World Map icon and city name zoom states updated
[*]World Map city names can now be localized in individual languages
[*]Mini Map added for player when out of vehicle
[*]World Map and Mini Map show vehicle position when out of vehicle
[*]Sizes and positions of HUD elements updated
[/list]


[b]General[/b]
[list][*]Performance has been improved and streaming has been optimized
[*]Frequency of passenger comments has been optimized
[/list]


[b]The update is now available for all via Steam.[/b] We'd love to hear your feedback. You can leave it in our forums and add screenshots and videos if you like: [url=https://www.tml-studios.de/forum/thread/1758-update-1-18-19587-feedback-bugs/]Update 1.18.19587 - Feedback & Bugs[/url]

notes.title: Update 1.17.17721 - Force Feedback, Seating Positions, and more
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26064558/dac8b8708c71d37927a9b826abdcb06c282ce65b.png[/img]


The long awaited Update 1.17 is now available for Fernbus Coach Simulator! In this update, we're adding two major and most wanted gameplay features: [b]Force Feedback[/b] and [b]adjustable driver seat position and driver camera[/b].

Along with other fixes, we have added [b]two web radio streams[/b] for your convenience while riding along Germany.

Also, Fernbus Simulator is now also available in Swedish.
Tack så mycket till (SWE)Rasmus för lokaliseringen!


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26064558/0e7baa39c7e42370cc3ca6c76c50552d79b9988a.png[/img]


[u]How to activate or adjust your Force Feedback[/u]:
Force Feedback should automatically be activated. If not, you can find it in the Options Menu under Game Options on the very bottom of the list.
[b]You can increase or decrease the following values:[/b]
[list][*]Spring Force - force of recentering while driving
[*]Damper Force - Dampening of the swivel resistance
[*]Road Effect Force - damages on the road and effect of the engine
[*]Collision Effect Force - for the intensity of impacts
[/list]


[u]How to change the seat position and driver camera[/u]:
You can change the seating position and driver camera by pressing the [b]Tab[/b] or Tabulator key on your keyboard.
On the bottom left, you should notice a new button with an icon, which obviously looks like a driver seat with and an eye.
Left click on the button and the menu for configuring your seating position and driver camera will appear.


[u]How to use the radio[/u]:
You can find the keys for the Radio in the Control Settings in the General category.
[b]Radio Hotkeys[/b]
[list][*]Volume Up - [b]Num-[/b]
[*]Volume Down - [b]Num+[/b]
[*]Switch Radio Channel - [b]Num*[/b]
[/list]


[h1]Patch Notes:[/h1]

[b]Gameplay[/b]:
[list][*]Force Feedback added including adjustment options
[*]Driver seat position and driver camera are now adjustable
[*]Events and vehicle malfunctions should work properly again
[*]Miscellaneous AI fixes in Cologne and Kassel
[/list]

[b]Vehicles[/b]:
[list][*]Interior mirror has been added to all ComfortClass variants
[*]ComfortClass Steam Achievements have been fixed
[/list]

[b]Audio[/b]:
[list][*]Web radio streams for Double Bass FM and Flashbass.FM added
[/list]

[b]Graphics[/b]:
[list][*]The vehicle selection scene now reacts to daytime, seasonal changes, and weather conditions
[*]Street lights, other night light sources, as well as glowing during daytime has been fixed
[*]Lighting at ZOB Berlin has been updated
[*]Vegetation will blend smoother
[*]Several minor to medium graphical issues have been fixed in the game world
[*]Player license plate fixed for cities, e.g. Frankfurt, Stralsund, Usedom, etc.
[/list]

[b]General[/b]:
[list][*]Various performance optimizations
[*]Input devices returning wrong values has been fixed
[/list]


The update is now available for all via Steam. We'd love to hear your feedback. You can leave it in our forums and add screenshots and videos if you like: [url=http://www.tml-studios.de/forum/thread/1599-update-1-17-17721-feedback-bugs/]Update 1.17.17721 - Feedback & Bugs[/url]


[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26064558/40aaa390edf00052312e56cfc3e226c0a67c836f.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26064558/344843676dbb30dd1405b5f488fe0c0847a9a14c.jpg[/img][/url] [url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26064558/8e5bb41032c9dbef356cb1cfc26a98c6eac59512.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26064558/6211c3b3e415f3a49a01f64f09f81cadb0920313.png[/img][/url]

Nach der Veröffentlichung von [url=http://www.tml-studios.de/forum/thread/714-fernbus-simulator-patch-notes/?postID=28595#post28595]Fernbus Simulator RELOADED[/url] und dem [url=http://www.tml-studios.de/forum/thread/1458-usedom-dlc-jetzt-erhältlich/]kostenlosen Usedom DLC[/url], geht es jetzt weiter mit dem [b]ComfortClass HD DLC[/b], dem [b]Multimedia Package DLC[/b] und der [b]Fernbus Simulator Platinum Edition[/b] von Aerosoft, die alle gemeinsam [b]jetzt erhältlich sind[/b]!

Allerhöchste Zeit, mal auf alle Inhalte einzugehen:

--

[h1]ComfortClass HD DLC[/h1]

[b]Preis: 12,95€ // [u]25% Rabatt bis zum 07.12.2017: 9,70€[/u][/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26064558/d0d597e09d6b7bf28234f403942cb236efc51d99.jpg[/img]

In diesem Paket erhaltet ihr einen Fuhrpark der Extraklasse mit [b]fünf vollfunktionsfähigen, detailgetreuen Varianten des ComfortClass HD[/b]. Von kompakt bis sitzplatzoptimiert findet ihr in den Hochdeckern der ComfortClass immer die richtige Wahl, wenn ihr eure anspruchsvollen Fahrgäste auf der Reisen durch Europa fahrt. Dank der Variantenvielfalt bietet diese Erweiterung eures Fuhrparks immer das richtige Fahrzeug für eure Anforderungen.

Das Cockpit ist konsequent auf den Komfort und das Wohlbefinden des Fahrers ausgelegt. Schon auf den ersten Blick strahlt es eine hohe Wertigkeit aus. Moderne Instrumentierung, optimale Übersicht und Bedienlogik verbinden sich zudem mit einer überdurchschnittlich hohen Gesamtergonomie.

Wir haben für euch die Modellreihe dieses zukunftsweisenden Fernbusses mit viel Leidenschaft und Liebe zum Detail nicht nur Äußerlich nachgebildet, sondern auch dem Fahrgefühl und der gesamten Geräuschkulisse ebenso viel Aufmerksamkeit zukommenlassen.

[u][b]Enthaltene Varianten:[/b][/u]
[list][*]ComfortClass S 515 HD
[*]ComfortClass S 516 HD
[*]ComfortClass S 516 HD-2
[*]ComfortClass S 517 HD
[*]ComfortClass S 519 HD

[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26064558/d9bf5b2bbd35a3e4788e5a745d33d9496ddf28d6.jpg][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26064558/c208abcda3bf747b69ae87601abf58fd4cfa5905.jpg[/img][/url]


[u][b]Features:[/b][/u]
[list][*]5 Varianten des ComfortClass HD im FlixBus-Design
[*]8-Gang automatisches Schaltgetriebe mit Gangvorwahlschalter
[*]Reaktive Displays, u.A. mit Information zu Geschwindigkeit und Abfahrbereitschaft
[*]Rollsperre und Haltestellenbremse mit Anfahrsperre
[*]Bedienbare Dachluken
[*]Detailliertes interaktives Bus-Cockpit mit umfangreichen Funktionen und verschiedenen Kameraansichten
[*]Bedienbare Klimaanlage
[*]Fahrermonitor mit Navigationssystem und Rückfahrkamera
[*]Kneeling-System
[*]Umfangreiche Beleuchtungssteuerung für Innen und Außen
[*]Bedienbares Fahrerfenster und Rollo

[b][u]TRAILER[/u]:[/b]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gXXTFHbEe3Y


http://store.steampowered.com/app/724420/Fernbus_Simulator__Comfort_Class_HD/


[url=http://www.tml-studios.de/forum/thread/1472-comfortclass-hd-dlc-multimedia-package-dlc-platinum-edition-jetzt-erhältlich/][b]Weitere Screenshots gibt es in unserem Forum[/b][/url]


--

[h1]Multimedia Package DLC[/h1]

[b]Preis: 3,99€[/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26064558/61ef7a3dddf3152846e929a26c4041b58367c42d.png[/img]

Wem die monotonen Motorgeräusche auf der Autobahn zu langweilig sind, bekommt sehr bald mehr auf die Ohren! Das Fernbus Simulator Multimedia Package beinhaltet ein vollwertiges Radio ohne Werbung, mit [b]über 70 lizensierten Titeln[/b], [b]Moderation[/b] inklusive [b]eigens produzierter Jingles[/b] und [b]interaktiver Verkehrsfunk[/b] sowie [b]Wettervorhersagen[/b] und [b]neuen variantenreichen Verkehrsbehinderungen[/b]!

[u][b]Features:[/b][/u]
[list][*]Werbefreies Radio
[*]über 70 Titel
[*]Moderation mit Small Talk und Jingles
[*]Wettervorhersage und Zeitansage
[*]neue Verkehrsbehinderungen
[*]Interaktiver Verkehrsfunk
[/list]


http://store.steampowered.com/app/602730/Fernbus_Simulator__Multimedia_Package/

--

[h1]Fernbus Simulator Platinum Edition[/h1]

[b]Preis: 39,95€ (Download) / 39,99€ (Box)[/b][/size]

[b]Achtung: Die Platinum Edition richtet sich an alle [u]Neukäufer[/u] des Spiels. Alle Inhalte sind auch für bestehende Besitzer einzeln erhältlich.[/b]

Jetzt ist der beliebte Fernbus Simulator, welcher in Kooperation mit FlixBus entwickelt wurde, auch als Platin Edition mit vielen bereits enthaltenen Extras wie zusätzlichen Bussen, Zielen, uvm. erhältlich.

Steuern Sie nicht nur den MAN Lion´s Coach, sondern auch den ComfortClass S HD oder den Reisebus der Extraklasse – den Neoplan Skyliner - bei Tag und Nacht und zu jeder Jahreszeit sicher über 2.000km fahrbare Strecke, die einer realen Streckenlänge von 20.000km entspricht. Im Inneren der Busse finden Sie originalgetreue Cockpits mit vielen Funktionen, die Außen-Designs der Busse können Sie dank des inkludierten Repaint Package selbst auswählen.

Diese Platinum Edition enthält neben mehr als 40 Städten wie Berlin, Hamburg, München, Köln oder Frankfurt und über 20 Sehenswürdigkeiten auch das Add-on Usedom, mit dem Sie Ihre Fahrgäste nun auch in die beliebte Urlaubsregion fahren können.

Zur Unterhaltung während der Fahrt steht Ihnen außerdem das Multimedia Package zur Verfügung. Dieses enthält neben einem werbefreien Radio auch einen interaktiven Verkehrsfunk, eine Wettervorhersage und über 70 lizensierte Songs aus Pop, Hip-Hop, RnB uvm.

Ein Routenplaner zum Erstellen eigener Linien und der interaktive Fahrgast Check-In sind natürlich auch enthalten und lassen Sie in den Alltag eines Fernbus-Fahrers eintauchen.


https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=I9DvS0aFWe0




Viele Grüße
Chris

notes.title: Usedom DLC - Now available for free!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

we're very proud to announce that the Usedom DLC for Fernbus Coach Simulator is now available for all [b]for free![/b]

The island of Usedom is the first free DLC for Fernbus Coach Simulator and contains two new destinations: The lido Ahlbeck and the city Usedom.

Usedom lies on the Baltic See and is divided between Germany and Poland. Beside the two new destinations, the DLC also includes a new bus depot in the city of Wolgast including the Peene bridge.

[h1]Features:[/h1]
[list][*]Two new destinations - Ahlbeck and Usedom
[*]Bus depot in Wolgast
[*]Several routes to the different destinations
[*]Peene bridge in Wolgast including train AI (train AI will be added with a future update)
[*]Highly detailed replica of the Baltic See island
[*]Interactive railroad crossings with train AI (train AI will be added with a future update)
[*]Camping spots, lighthouses, and several small villages[/list]


The DLC is now available for all via Steam and should be added to the game automatically.

We hope you'll have a lot of fun! Please don't forget to leave your feedback: [url=http://www.tml-studios.de/forum/thread/1459-usedom-dlc-feedback/]Usedom DLC - Feedback[/url]

Best regards,
Chris


http://store.steampowered.com/app/686280/Fernbus_Simulator__Usedom/

[b]Fernbus Coach Simulator RELOADED[/b] - The [b]biggest update yet[/b] for Fernbus Coach Simulator is now available!

Update 1.15 updates Fernbus Simulator to Unreal Engine Version 4.16.3. This should especially bring optimized loading times. We have intensively worked on the performance of the game and improved it in many situations. Starting with loading times, over lighting and shadow rendering, to overall improvements in frame rates. The SkyDome and lighting systems have been improved with the help of your feedback. Thanks to all for the amazing help! Adding to that, many cities have been updated and partially expanded. The update also includes the brand new city of Stralsund. We've put a lot of effort in proving the AI traffic and adding new features to it. The physics and sound systems of all coaches have been improved as well for a more authentic and realistic experience.

There have been a lot of minor and major additional improvements and fixes, which you can read through in detail in the patch notes.

We hope you will enjoy this update and an overall improved Fernbus Coach Simulator Reloaded!

You can leave your feedback in our forum and add screenshots or videos: [url=http://www.tml-studios.de/forum/thread/1422]Update 1.15.15354 - Feedback & Bugs - Fernbus Simulator Reloaded[/url]

--

[b]General[/b]
[list][*]Texture Streaming fixed
[*]Camera position when pausing the game has been fixed[/list]

[b]Performance Fixes[/b]
[list][*]Loading times
[*]Cities at night
[*]CPU performance
[*]Performance of mirrors
[*]General rendering optimizations
[*]Installation and download sizes reduced[/list]

[b]World[/b]

notes.title: Update 1.15.15354 - Fernbus Simulator Reloaded
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26064558/dac8b8708c71d37927a9b826abdcb06c282ce65b.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26064558/8cb97d982f7c7f62b9f0b06b653357e299d90774.png[/img]

[b]Fernbus Coach Simulator RELOADED[/b] - The [b]biggest update yet[/b] for Fernbus Coach Simulator is now available!

Update 1.15 updates Fernbus Simulator to Unreal Engine Version 4.16.3. This should especially bring optimized loading times. We have intensively worked on the performance of the game and improved it in many situations. Starting with loading times, over lighting and shadow rendering, to overall improvements in frame rates. The SkyDome and lighting systems have been improved with the help of your feedback. Thanks to all for the amazing help! Adding to that, many cities have been updated and partially expanded. The update also includes the brand new city of Stralsund. We've put a lot of effort in proving the AI traffic and adding new features to it. The physics and sound systems of all coaches have been improved as well for a more authentic and realistic experience.

There have been a lot of minor and major additional improvements and fixes, which you can read through in detail in the patch notes.

We hope you will enjoy this update and an overall improved Fernbus Coach Simulator Reloaded!

You can leave your feedback in our forum and add screenshots or videos: [url=http://www.tml-studios.de/forum/thread/1422]Update 1.15.15354 - Feedback & Bugs - Fernbus Simulator Reloaded[/url]

--

[h1]Patch Notes:[/h1]

[b]General[/b]
[list][*]Texture Streaming fixed
[*]Camera position when pausing the game has been fixed[/list]

[b]Performance Fixes[/b]
[list][*]Loading times
[*]Cities at night
[*]CPU performance
[*]Performance of mirrors
[*]General rendering optimizations
[*]Installation and download sizes reduced[/list]

[b]Controls[/b]
[list][*]Option for linear and nonlinear axis input added. You can find this option in the Game Options under "Speed Dependent Steering"[/list]

[b]World[/b]
[list][*]SkyDome improved
[*]New city: Stralsund
[*]"Rügen bridge" and "Ziegelgraben bridge" added
[*]New road surfaces and according sounds added
[*]Cities updated:
- Augsburg
- Berlin
- Bremen
- Dortmund
- Frankfurt a.M.
- Freiburg
- Hamburg
- Hannover
- Cologne
- Leipzig
- Mainz
- Munich
- Stuttgart
[*]Highway blockages deactivated
[*]Dark tunnel at A9 fixed

[b]Graphics[/b]
[list][*]Lighting updated
[*]Passengers shouldn't spawn on roofs anymore
[*]Flying or stuck parking vehicles should be fixed
[*]Shadows updated
[*]Lights of street lamps and other lamps have been updated
[*]Lights of traffic lights have been updated
[*]Lights of vehicles have been updated
[*]Lighting of crossroads and bus stops have been improved
[*]Lighting in tunnels has been updated
[*]Shaders of passengers have been updated
[*]Sizes of agricultural plants has been updated
[*]Rapeseed shouldn't grow during winter anymore[/list]

[b]AI (Vehicles and Passengers)[/b]
[list][*]Behavior of vehicles in curves and during lane changes has been improved
[*]Behavior of vehicles at traffic lights and crossroads has been improved
[*]The acceleration of vehicles at ascends has been improved
[*]Passengers waiting at bus stops will no longer walk around wildly
[*]Physic of passengers luggage has been fixed
[*]The flickering of braking lights has been fixed[/list]

[b]Vehicle[/b]
[list][*]Vehicle physics has been improved
[*]Field Of View of the driver camera has been improved
[*]Control of the driver camera has been updated
[*]High beam of the coaches has been improved
[*]The interior passenger lights in the rear of the MAN Lion's Coach C has been improved
[*]UVs of the Lion's Coach C has been fixed
[*]The passenger monitor in Arcade Mode will now activate automatically
[*]Improved the overall texture quality of the dashboard textures[/list]

[b]GUI[/b]
[list][*]Incorrect tooltips in Arcade Mode have been fixed
[*]Display of current speed in the HUD should now be displayed correctly
[*]Zoom of the world map has been improved
[*]World map will now zoom on current position of the player[/list]

[b]Saving and Loading[/b]
[list][*]Savegames with a dot/full stop (.) will now be displayed correctly [/list]

[b]Achievements[/b]
[list][*]Achievements for "Taking a Break" should now work properly[/list]

[b]Audio[/b]
[list][*]Added option for Stereo and Surround 5.1 Sound (Standard is set to Stereo)
[*]5.1 sound improved
[*]Sound of the coaches engines and driving noise have been overhauled
[*]Driving noise of various road surfaces have been added
[*]AI vehicle sounds have been improved
[*]Ambient sounds have been improved[/list]


The update is now available for all via Steam!

[/list]

  - Berlin
  - Bremen
  - Dortmund
  - Frankfurt a.M.
  - Freiburg
  - Hamburg
  - Hannover
  - Köln
  - Leipzig
  - Mainz
  - München
  - Stuttgart

[*]Flying or stuck vehicles should be removed
[*]Shadows updated
[*]Lights of street lamps and other lamps have been updated
[*]Lights of traffic lights have been updated
[*]Lights of vehicles have been updated
[*]Lighting of crossroads and bus stops have been improved
[*]Lighting in tunnels has been updated
[*]Shaders of passengers have been updated
[*]Sizes of agricultural plants has been updated
[*]Rapeseed shouldn't grow during winter anymore
[/list]


[b]AI (Vehicles and Passengers)[/b]:
[list][*]Behavior of vehicles in curves and during lane changes has been improved
[*]Behavior of vehicles at traffic lights and crossroads has been improved
[*]The acceleration of vehicles at ascends has been improved
[*]Passengers waiting at bus stops will no longer walk around wildly as if they have no life
[*]Physic of passengers luggage has been fixed
[*]The flickering of braking lights has been fixed
[/list]


[b]Vehicle[/b]:
[list][*][b]Vehicle physics have been improved[/b]
[*]Field Of View of the driver camera has been improved
[*]Control of the driver camera has been updated
[*]High beam of the coaches has been improved
[*]The interior passenger lights in the rear of the MAN Lion's Coach C has been improved
[*]UVs of the Lion's Coach C has been fixed
[*]The passenger monitor in arcade will now activate automatically
[*][b]Improved the overall texture quality of the dashboard textures[/b]
[/list]


[b]GUI[/b]:
[list][*]Incorrect tool tips in Arcade Mode have been fixed
[*]Display of current speed in the HUD should now be displayed correctly
[*]Zoom of the World Map has been improved
[*]World Map will now zoom on current position of the player
[/list]


[b]Saving and Loading[/b]:
[list][*]Save games with a dot/full stop (.) will now be displayed correctly
[/list]


[b]Achievements[/b]:
[list][*]Achievements for "Taking a Break" should now work properly
[/list]


[b]Audio[/b]:
[list][*]5.1 Sound improved
[*]Sound of the coaches engines and driving noise have been overhauled
[*]Driving noise of various road surfaces have been added
[*]AI vehicle sounds have been improved
[*]Ambient sounds have been improved
[/list]


As usual, we'd love to hear your feedback during the beta phase of this update. With your help, we can make each update as flawless as possible.

You can leave your feedback in our forums and add screenshots or videos: [url=http://www.tml-studios.de/forum/thread/1391-beta-update-1-15-14439-feedback-bugs/]BETA Update 1.15.14439 - Feedback & Bugs[/url].

notes.title: The Future of Fernbus Coach Simulator
notes.content:
Dear Community,

our biggest project yet, Fernbus Coach Simulator, was released almost a year ago and we're continuously getting asked: [b]What's next?![/b] Are we going to continue supporting the game? Are there going to be more updates? New content? DLCs? Well, let's talk about it!

Of course there are still going to be a bunch of updates with new features, fixes, and all that is needed to ensure a great gaming experience. But there is much more that's coming up! Here's an overview... Ready? Let's rock!

--

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26064558/d7d51b519d7ee3a9b37fd1ec903017854a671ad2.png[/img]

The initial release of the [b]Modding Tools[/b] for Fernbus Coach Simulator is only a few days away! These tools will enable you to edit the existing map and adding contents to it. You can even start creating your very own map, which will be as easy as you could even imagine: For [b]whole Europe[/b], the actual areas will already be included inside the Modding Tools, including the [b]right scale[/b], [b]height data[/b], and [b]coordinates[/b], as an orientation guide. You can simply start placing your streets and objects just like that! Stay tuned for the most easy and powerful way to edit in Fernbus Coach Simulator - Even [b]without any programming or 3D knowledge[/b]! [b]Video tutorials[/b] will help you create your very own first mod. Starting at initial release, we will publish videos that explain all the basics, and new episodes will follow that will explain the more detailed stuff. We just can't wait to see your first Mods!

[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26064558/bb13f75b96fe3792b5c3d8f1c004a7e62cd390e1.jpg][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26064558/8d4cbc2636f8b34e734c13666efcd1210afb5500.jpg[/img][/url]

--

[h1]Map DLCs - Austria, Switzerland and France[/h1]

As our Modding Tools are just before release, we already want to announce that we're working on official [b]Map DLCs[/b]: Austria and Switzerland (together), and France will be released as DLCs for Fernbus Coach Simulator, enabling you to ride your bus internationally! Time to learn new German accents. And French.

[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26064558/00b90ad48e80f4f52e2d31082afbe601cea55e1c.jpg][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26064558/b9c602c1bf923f6507536ae210348b0bd3c0adcb.jpg[/img][/url] [url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26064558/01d9a8779e322ebf427ee2cb61367eff47b0f27f.jpg][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26064558/4c09319b86e629af94f52f1ff52d6545a60a312e.jpg[/img][/url] [url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26064558/424d011aa1371709ad57a3946c384687f6f02c32.jpg][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26064558/9d17ee3703ffb5fd1d99182b2e67be77c37fc845.jpg[/img][/url] [url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26064558/c46d65ff9a980fa8a7ef7b4db7d17ba5ef90bbf0.jpg][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26064558/ce5456f413450328fe5906e4d957a6102c728e4e.jpg[/img][/url] [url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26064558/1bfe1df7682686d6ada239acb52a4f465d669645.jpg][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26064558/6a1df4dc80549a202242b2c20c023d0a43505d57.jpg[/img][/url]

--

[h1]Usedom - Free DLC with exclusive new content![/h1]

It's island time! Yes, Germany has islands. Usedom is coming to Fernbus Coach Simulator as a [b]free DLC[/b]! But that's not all: This Feature Package will include many new contents for the game, including [b]new props for the Modding Tools[/b], [b]brand new vegetation[/b] that will bring a great new graphical experience into the game, and [b]working railroad crossings[/b] that might eventually cause you to wait a minute or two. We will soon announce the official release date of this DLC!

[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26064558/6d81df30ebdc06a4af1263dc64bc2e6891420dd0.jpg][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26064558/4acb90532a61e5f21e39a14bded44ee732f58eef.jpg[/img][/url] [url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26064558/1a024f2c097c960330037f9ae787e881cf228cf1.jpg][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26064558/0976ac6bf6a78636c476c8e16285a41229405e11.jpg[/img][/url] [url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26064558/73fc27982003f2a3626641f33739c89796424022.jpg][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26064558/393dc4dedf88feac668f5d74a35a8f05d4571936.jpg[/img][/url] [url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26064558/c2602b7b21cdb80158abfd4e50ae334692739f61.jpg][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26064558/59ffcf81429d4dd786700f762d923a780565abb4.jpg[/img][/url] [url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26064558/67169be6cadf35a317b321e625ab003672fdecf6.jpg][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26064558/02b30a3cc6383cc703acc681d835db06e67d96c6.jpg[/img][/url] [url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26064558/9770b2b661b2abcf99817eb835d95c6276457fa9.jpg][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26064558/6b39ce0dd4981d9e32cdda93900256bbb1f5ec93.jpg[/img][/url] [url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26064558/98fdd357ae1d4adc2fd00886856fd34519586717.jpg][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26064558/5040c7832734efff68fcc463ee39688ebf54c74d.jpg[/img][/url] [url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26064558/e40cfa2280d3c5743c7edd7a7268152a20fd3ca1.jpg][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26064558/013ca8a0978f9dbf76f9a100b320cde9531dd284.jpg[/img][/url] [url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26064558/e868a687159c2651dd080d2d2a16d0ca690f9a8e.jpg][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26064558/48128a8b9a01f2bc482d95f44f52ecdfdcc8b802.jpg[/img][/url]

--

[h1]New Buses[/h1]

Who said that there wouldn't be more coming up after the Neoplan Skyliner? Well, we have a little more coming up. There will be [b]at least two bus packages[/b]: One VDL package with 6 bus variants and another package with 5 bus variants of the ComfortClass. More details to follow...

[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26064558/60a6de7467ca9b88f88a23316bbe8e4fc32b627d.png][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26064558/3bd869ea2cca005226d914dbc2fb3a3ebfe0c84c.png[/img][/url]

--

[h1]Multimedia DLC - Fernbus Coach Simulator Entertainment Package[/h1]

Now this is really one of the wishes we've heard the most! The Fernbus Coach Simulator Entertainment Package will include a [b]full featured Radio[/b] without commercials, over 70 licensed music titles, a MC with [b]original jingles[/b], an [b]interactive radio traffic service[/b] with [b]weather forecasts[/b] and [b]new traffic disturbances[/b]!

--

[h1]Bundesliga DLC[/h1]

Who said that your only job would be to drive passengers through Germany? Get ready to start your [b]next challenge[/b]! The new season of the German Soccer League (Bundesliga) is starting and [b]YOU[/b] are the [b]bus driver of your favorite team[/b]. Bring the players to their games, make sure to drive responsibly, keep your bus clean and drive through the washer, keep the drinks fridge filled up and make sure to have a fair Wi-Fi on board. Make sure to head to the repair shop before it's too late, and compare prices of petrol stations, hotels, and more to find the best offer. Spending too much money won't make your boss happy, but being too stingy won't make your players happy. This is a new chapter - And you decide where it goes! We will soon detail the current development of this DLC here in our forums.

--

Of course, regular updates will also be released here and then, making sure to keep the game stable and adding constant improvements to functions and graphics, as well as interactions in the Germany map. We will also completely revise the AI system - we know it's you're biggest wish - and will take time to make Force Feedback better.

We hope you like our plans for 2017 and 2018 regarding Fernbus Coach Simulator. Tell us what you think!

Best regards,
Chris


Visit our forums to stay in touch with us: http://www.tml-studios.de/forum

We have a new BETA Update waiting for you! Update 1.15 updates Fernbus Simulator to [b]Unreal Engine Version 4.15.3[/b].  Above all, you should experience much [b]better loading times[/b].

[/list]

[list][*]Added an option for linear and non-linear Axis Inputs, to be found as "Speed Dependent Steering" in the Game Options
[/list]

[b]Graphic + World[/b]
[list][*]Fixed very low AI traffic in some cities
[*]Lighting has been updated

[*]There should be no more passengers spawning on roofs in Berlin
[*]Floating license plates in Konstanz removed
[*]Passenger monitor now activates automatically in Arcade Mode
[/list]

[/list]

[/list]

[b]This update is not compatible with MODs that were created with the Closed Beta Modding Tools. Please deactivate all your MODs via the Main Menu in Fernbus Simulator before you start the game. Crashes may occur if not done so. This does [u]not[/u] affect repaints.[/b]
[b]The MODs need to be updated using the Modding Tools 4.15 in order to be fully functional with the according version of the simulator.[/b]

The Modding Tools are currently in Closed Beta and thus aren't publicly available yet.

[b]CAUTION: This is a BETA Update. Please note that this version can cause technical problems and/or may cause instability of your computer system.[/b]

notes.title: Update 1.13.12452
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26064558/dac8b8708c71d37927a9b826abdcb06c282ce65b.png[/img]

In this update we have included a [b]new lighting system[/b] with Color Grading and Bloom. There is a new category in the graphics options, with adjustments for Gamma, Color Grading and Bloom.

We've invested quite some time on our [b]new NPC models[/b] to make them as performant as possible. These new passenger models also come with all new animations, which we want to expand in the future.

The [b]Kochertal Viaduct along the A6[/b], between Heilbronn and Nuremberg, has been added, including the Kochertal Valley and new resting areas.
We have also changed the look of the street bariers, making them less eye-catching, and we've optimized the [b]traffic light behavior[/b] in all cities to improve traffic flow.

Additionally, several graphical issues have been fixed and new achievements added. The windows of all coaches have been updated, which should fix shading, reflections and Anti-Aliasing bugs and artefacts.

And last but not least, thanks to diligent help the [b]Italian localisation[/b] is now available. Mille grazie!
--

[list][*]Lighting system updated

[*][b]New NPC models added[/b]
[*]Front windows of all coaches updated
[*]Rear and side windows of all coaches updated
[*]Big truck rear lights have been fixed
[*]License plate text readability has been improved
[/list]

[b]World:[/b]
[list][*]Kochertalviadukt added (A6 between Heilbronn + Nürnberg)

[*]Traffic lights in all cities updated
[/list]

[b]Achievements:[/b]
[list][*]New achievements have been added, some may be hidden
[*]Some achievements have been fixed and should work correctly now
[/list]

[b]General:[/b]
[list][*]Application name has been changed from "Unreal Engine" to "Fernbus Simulator"
[*]Application icon now shows the correct image
[*]A loading background has been added in between videos and main menu
[/list]

[b]Localisation:[/b]
[list][*]Italian added to available languages
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.12.11876
notes.content:
In this Update, you'll receive some new content and overhauled features free of charge, e.g. the new Sound Engine, which we've been working on for the last quarter. The "break"-mechanic has been improved, and also the A7 has been fully reconstructed. Prepare yourselves for a racy and tuneful Roller coaster ride!

Should you have active repaints subscribed from the Workshop, the game start - after you clicked on "Start Game" in the Main Menu - might take a bit to load, due to the changes we made to the texture memory of mod repaints, in order to additionally improve texture streaming.


[b][u]Audio[/u][/b]
[list][*][b]MAN Lion's Coaches sounds updated to new Sound Engine[/b]
[*][b]AI vehicle sounds updated to new Sound Engine[/b]
[*][b]Ambient sound updated to new Sound Engine[/b]
[/list]


[b][u]GUI[/u][/b]
[list][*]Added a crosshair for checking passengers after the break
[*]It should be easier now to check passengers sitting in the second row
[*]The coaches in the selection screen should switch correctly now when returning from the customization menu
[*]Missing images of mods in the menu haven been fixed
[/list]


[b][u]Graphics[/u][/b]
[list][*]Shadows updated
[*][b]V-Sync added[/b]
[*][b]Resolution scale can now manually be set to 200%[/b] (this should make the virtual world and objects much sharper)
[*]Loading times have been updated
[*]Texture streaming improved
[*]Reconstruction of the  A7 near  the city of Kassel has been completed
[/list]


[b][u]Game[/u][/b]
[list][*]A traffic AI crash has been fixed
[*]The collision of signs has been fixed
[/list]


As always, we would love to hear your feedback to this update! [url=http://www.tml-studios.de/forum/thread/1209]Hit this link[/url] to start typing...

notes.title: Stable Update 1.11.11608
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26064558/dac8b8708c71d37927a9b826abdcb06c282ce65b.png[/img]

The beta phase of patch 1.11 has been finalized. We've been able to fix some additional bugs thanks to your feedback.

In addition to that we've been able to fix two AI issues. The AI won't drive into trucks trailer anymore. The braking lights flickering while waiting at traffic lights has been fixed.

We've also updated the standard repaint of both MAN Lion's Coaches according to the international design. You'll still find the old release repaint in the customization labelled as "Fernbus Sim Release" and another new repaint can be found in the list as well. A neutral white repaint with Flixbus decals.

[b]AI[/b]

notes.title: Hotfix 1.10.11383
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26064558/98067a40e48ddf7073b9d7a6661d3ace3a8d7afb.png[/img]

Some users reported us they got troubles with their save games and error messages like [b]LowLevelFatalError[/b] which might not start Fernbus Simulator at all with the latest update. We released a new hotfix today which should fix this issue.

If you backed up your old save game, make sure to replace and recover it. For those who started a new game and backed up their save game:
[list]
[*] Open up Windows Explorer and navigate to your local Fernbus Simulator App Data. [b]In most cases: C:\Users\<your username>\AppData\Local\Fernbus\Saved\SaveGames[/b]
[*] If you backed up your old profile, replace Profile.sav. [b]If your file got created prior February 10th, you don't need to make any changes.[/b]
[*]Start Fernbus Simulator, your old save game should work like expected.
[/list]

As usual, if you encounter any troubles with Fernbus Simulator, make sure to reach us out on our official support center (http://www.tml-studios.de/forum/support/) and our community hub for gameplay related issues.

notes.title: Patch 1.10.11359
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26064558/dac8b8708c71d37927a9b826abdcb06c282ce65b.png[/img]

We've updated the UV Layout of both MAN coaches. Thus the side and rear windows are now available for modders to add their designs.
This change of layout may eventually cause some errors on current repaints, shouldn't they haven't been updated with this patch. We're sorry any inconvience, but are sure you will enjoy the changes as soon as the modders have updated theit repaints accordingly.

Also the highway A7 is partially in reconstruction, in order to give it its destinctive look and feel. And last but not least we've focused on bug fixing.
See the list below for details:

[b]Coaches[/b]
[list]

[*]Indicators can now be disabled with the button, which activatedthem.

[*]Rear view camera will now activate correctly, when the gear switch is set manually using the mouse

notes.title: Patch 1.6.10369
notes.content:
Finally we're back with a new update! This patch includes full TrackIR support, dramatic performance improvements, and we have added stationary buses at some central bus stations. The update is available now!
With several updates that have been released until now, we would be happy to read new Steam reviews based on your current opinion on the game!

[h1][b]Game Engine[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Updated to Unreal Engine 4.13
[/list]

[h1][b]Input Devices[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Added TrackIR Support
[list]
[*]Needs to be activated in Game Options
[*]In TrackIR Software "Check for Game Updates..." have to be executed
[*]In TrackIR Software deactivate "Trap" at all hotkey because this blocks the keys in the game
[*]Press key "Cockpitkamera" (2) another time to center the view
[/list]
[*]Force Feedback in MAN Lion's Coach and Lion's Coach C adjusted
[*]Crash fixed caused through many connected input devices
[/list]

[h1][b]Performance[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Overall CPU performance improved
[*]Mirror performance improved
[*]Coach performance improved
[/list]

[h1][b]Gameplay[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug in "Taking a break". You need to check all passengers inside the coach first, before you can check-in new passengers
[*]Visualisation of Marked Areas updated and added Symbols for Bus Stops, Depot, Gas Stations, Parking and Police Checks
[*]Fixed starting from Depot in Freeplay
[*]Bar barrier fixed
[*]Dashbaord buttons can not be used anymore in Arcade Mode
[/list]

[h1][b]UI[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Added tool tips added for Dashboard buttons
[*]Leaderboards inside the player profile now show correct
[/list]

[h1][b]Menues[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Saving is now possible, if you deleted the save games name and start writing again
[*]Gamepad and Mouse axis are now able to be added as input
[/list]

[h1][b]Graphics[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Additional Levels of Detail for vegetation and various other assets
[*]Added stationary MAN Coaches at Bus Stations (Berlin, Munich, Cologne, Hamburg und Halle)
[/list]

[h1][b]Vehicles[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Inside mirror activated (when mirror quality at "Epic")
[*]Rear fog light in Lion's Coach C fixed
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.5.9726
notes.content:
In today's update you'll find one of the first major overhauls: A completely revised Resting mechanic. Additionally we added some fixes to AI lane changing and spawning, improved the games performance and added NPC state icons.
You can find the full list of fixes and updates in the change log below.

[h1][b]Level Art[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Tunnel Entrance/Exit Collisions fixed
[*]Lighting fixed at certain bus stops
[*]Let's Player ads updated
[/list]

[h1][b]Graphics[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Material fixed of the Police Check Marker
[/list]

[h1][b]Gameplay[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Resting overhaul:[/b]
[olist]
[*]When driving longer that 4h, you can now take a break after 2h of driving at Gas Stations, Service Areas or Bus Stops with a bonus to statistics, or anywhere else with a malus to statistics
[*]Added preconditions for taking a break: The bus needs to stand still, with engine off, doors opened and driver outside the vehicle.
[*]When rested, you're required to check the passengers and send the passenger count to Central via the "Check" Button in your Smartphone
[*]"Simple Resting" added to Control Mode Options
[*]"Resting Quality" added to Service Statistics
[*]"Missing Passengers" added to Service Statistics
[/olist]
[*]Events fixed (Police Control and Highway Blockages will now appear correctly)
[/list]

[h1][b]Performance[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Technical and graphical performance improvements
[/list]

[h1][b]GUI[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Leaderboard position fixed in player profile
[*]Added state icons to NPC (can be disabled in Game Options, with the exception for Resting)
[/list]

[h1][b]AI[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Lane changing on Crossroads and in Tunnels disabled
[*]AI Spawning updated at Frankfurt Airport and around Service Areas and Gas Stations
[/list]

notes.content:
The update today features many small improvements and optimizations regarding the AI. The traffic AI now behaves more comfortable on highways. We also implemented basic force feedback support which is going to be further improved with future updates. In the main menu you can now access the leaderboards and compete with other players. [/list]

[*]Braking without any reason fixed
[*]Flickering of braking lights while standing fixed
[*]Less trucks on mid lane

[/list]

[h1]Menu/HUD[/h1]

[*]Highscore/Leaderboards added to main menu
[*]New HUD element: "General Information" shows speed, time, next stop, scheduled arrival/departure
[*]Added information of saved games (only for new saved games)
[*]Change weather via smartphone (cloud symbol on the top left corner)
[*]Some menues adjusted for various resolutions
[/list]

[h1]Languages[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added slovak (not officially supported by steam. Only available in game)
[/list]

[h1]World[/h1]
[list]
[*]The lanterns at the depot are switched off at the daytime
[*]The depot is more lit at nighttime
[*]Spawning at certain depots which caused the Lions Coach C to get stuck is fixed
[*]Improved dynamic weather
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.2.9377
notes.content:
We published a new update for Fernbus Coach Simulator today which contains several improvements and additions. We finally implemented a mouse steering option and a steering camera which can be enabled or disabled in the options. We also implemented our first set of modding with repaints. You're able to select a new repaint based on the old branding design by MeinFernbus Flixbus and we also offer templates for creating own repaints on our forums. License plates can be created too when selecting your ride. Have fun!

[h1]Coach[/h1]
[list]
[*] White placeholder cube removed
[*] Headlight, fog light and long distance light updated
[*] Font size of current speed in display increased
[*] Steering camera implemented. The camera turns with the steering of the coach. Strength is configureable in the game settings menu.
[*] Look left/right keys turns the camera now instead of immediately switching it
[*] Camera centers automatically while driving (deactivatable in game settings)
[*] Raining into the back of the Lions Coach C fixed
[*] Repainting functionality added to the coaches
[*] Old "MeinFernbus Flixbus" design added as repaint, changable in the "Customize" menu
[*] License Plate added to the coach, changable in the "Customize" menu
[/list]

[h1]Traffic AI[/h1]
[list]
[*] Congestion at crossroad will now be detected to avoid blocking
[*] Braking behaviour updated
[*] Some materials of cars were changed
[/list]

[h1]Menu/HUD[/h1]
[list]
[*] Intro Video starts immediately at game start while loading. After Loading it is skippable
[*] Values in game settings menu are now displayed as 0-100 ranges instead of 0-1 ranges
[*] Back functionality is now triggered by escape key in most menus
[*] Menu music starts at finishing a route now too
[*] Additional information added to the navigation HUD: Current speed, current time, next stop, departure/arrival time
[*] Small design improvements in main menu
[/list]

[h1]Inputs[/h1]
[list]
[*] Mouse steering added. Middle mouse button will activate it
[*] Preparations were added for auto configuration of input devices. Currently the database for devices is empty. Every time the inputs are applied in the menu a configuration file is written to disk. This file contains all informations for connected devices. You can find this file in "C:\Users\<your username>\AppData\Local\Fernbus\Settings\Devices". If you want you can send us this file to update the database.
[/list]

[h1]World[/h1]
[list]
[*] Reflective street signs will now be illuminated by the coach
[*] Some materials fixed
[*] Lighting of "Kölner Dom" fixed
[/list]

[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
[list]
[*] A blendscreen was added when using timelaps or resetting the vehicle location
[*] "Continue" the route is now only available when starting at the current station
[*] The probability of events was increased
[/list]

notes.title: Patch note 02/09/2016
notes.content:
Dear Steam Community,

since the Fernbus Coach Simulator release last Thursday the TML team has busy day and night addressing the unfortunately occurred problems. The information and crash dumps you’ve posted have been a tremendous help in tracking down and fixing these issues. Many thanks for your support! We’re glad to now release the first big patch, and hope that it improves the playing experience for all of you. It’s been a huge amount of work for our small team and we appreciate your patience and understanding. 

See below for the patch notes:

[b]Coaches[/b]
[list]
[*]Rain drops appear on the windscreen of the Lion's Coach
[*]Air Condition shows the correct temperasture after loading a savegame
[*]Sound of the doors is played correctly
[*]Sound of rain drops on the coaches roof added
[*]Announcement can now be deactivted at any time
[*]Engine ca no more be deactivated in Arcade-Mode
[/list]
[b]Passengers[/b]
[list]
[*]Passenger Voices added
[*]Subtitles fixed (Font color, Order and Flickering)
[*]Passengers comments appear pormptly
[*]Passenger comments (too slow) albeit maintaining speed limit of 60 km/h fixed
[/list]
[b]Menues[/b]
[list]
[*]Difficulty "Simple" (control mode) renamed "Arcade"
[*]Control Mode Dialogue added (Arcade or Realistic)
[*]Routen Editor: "Custom" renamed "Career"
[*]Game Mode Dialogue added (Career or Freeplay)
[*]FOV (Field of View) adjustability is reduced to inbetween 60° and 90°
[*]Main Menu background music added
[*]Loading Screen background image added
[*]Main Menu background images added
[*]Main Menu design slightly changed
[*]Two coaches in Menues fixed
[*]Added image for unlocked Cities in Route Editor
[*]Audio volumes fixed
[/list]
[b]Navigation[/b]
[list]
[*]Speed limits in Navigation fixed
[*]Speed limits and Distances in Freeplay disabled
[*]Navigation of the following Cities have been fixed: Konstanz, Augsburg, Saarbrücken, Halle
[*]Navigation starting from Depot fixed
[*]Speed limits for Frankfurt Airport, Berlin ZOB, Köln ZOB, München ZOB, Hamburg ZOB, Halle ZOB fixed
[/list]
[b]Languages[/b]
[list]
[*]Localisation fixed (English, German)
[/list]
[b]Inputs[/b]
[list]
[*]Simplification of Axis-Adjustment via presets (Standard, Standard 0-1, Inverterted, Inverterted 1-0)
[*]When adding a new Axis a preview helps with Adjustments
[*]Invalid (None) Inputs removed from Standard controls
[/list]
[b]Tooltips[/b]
[list]
[*]Tooltips updated
[*]Tooltip "Follow the navigation to..." will show up at Bus Stops and Offroad from now on
[/list]
[b]Profile[/b]
[list]
[*]Profile Setup updated
[*]Reseting a Profile will now show the Unlocks correctly
[/list]
[b]Statistics[/b]
[list]
[*]Driven kilometers will now show correctly
[/list]
[b]Graphics[/b]
[list]
[*]Some LODs (Levels of Detail) updated
[/list]
[b]Audio[/b]
[list]
[*]Certain Sound volumes updated
[/list]

notes.title: Important Community Info
notes.content:
[b]Dear Steam community,[/b]

some players have told us that they cannot start the Fernbus Coach Simulator, have problems with background applications or AI traffic behaving not as expected. We are constantly working on fixing those problems and will release updates shortly, next week at latest, that fix these critical issues. Following that, we will improve and extend hardware support, e.g. regarding controllers and TrackIR. The bug fixes are top priority, though. 

Underneath you find a feature list that unfortunately didn't make it yet into the game. As soon as the critical fixes are done we will focus all our resscources on the following features (not sorted chronologically) that will be added to the game with several updates in the coming days and weeks.weeks.

[list]
[*]Ingame languages: Danish, Dutch, French, Greek, Hungarian, Polish, Russian, Slowakian, Spanish, Turkish
[*]Music in main menu
[*]Radio stream in bus
[*]Signs to be lighted with spotlights
[*]Sound files for passengers
[*]Force Feedback
[*]TrackIR
[*]New passenger and pedestrian AI
[*]Repaint functionality
[*]AI buses at bus stops/stations and on the roads
[*]Highscores (online comparison with rankings of other users)
[*]City of Kassel
[*]More detailes navigation system: Autobahn and rural roads can be individually set for more detailed route creation
[*]Navigation in free ride from one point to the other
[*]Mouse steering
[*]Controller (Gamepad) support
[*]Import and export of created routes
[*]Modding Level Editor
[*]Deco for driver's seat
[/list]

We ask for your understanding and thank you very much for your patience.

[b]Aerosoft[/b]

notes.title: Worldwide Fernbus Coach Simulator launch on August 25th
notes.content:
We’re proud to release the Fernbus Coach Simulator by TML-Studios, a high-end simulation product on the Unreal Engine 4. Accurate in every detail while giving the gamer the chance to explore around 20.000 km of the German route network of FlixBus and more than 40 recreated cities. The time factor is 1:10, keeping the scheduled routes interesting while the streaming is really smooth thanks to TML. Drive through fantastic landscapes to your destination and enjoy the great level of detail of the interior and exterior of the buses. Get into action and become a bus driver! 

Thank you for your support,
Aerosoft
